mentions.name: LWIR fire mapping diffusion fine-tuning
mentions.description: This project fine-tunes image models so diffusion can output LWIR (long-wave infrared) fire mapping data from RGB picture images; work so far includes manually labeling and matching RGB and LWIR image pairs and finding better pose matches when the flights differ.
mentions.source_excerpt: learning how to fine tune image models, for an attempt at getting diffusion to output LWIR fire mapping data from RGB picture images
